# 小米录音机增强 / Mi Recorder Enhancer

为小米录音机增加筛选等实用功能。

Adds filtering and other useful features to Xiaomi Recorder.

## 功能 / Features

- 按位置、时长、日期和文字转写状态筛选录音 / Filter recordings by location, duration, date, and transcription status
- 手动触发单条或批量文字转写 / Manually transcribe one or multiple recordings

## 环境 / Requirements

- Android 13+
- 支持现代 Xposed API 的 LSPosed / LSPosed with modern Xposed API support
- 小米录音机 `7.8.9.9`（已验证）/ Xiaomi Recorder `7.8.9.9` (verified)

安装后，在 LSPosed 中启用“小米录音机增强”并重启小米录音机。模块静态作用域为 `com.android.soundrecorder`。

After installation, enable the module in LSPosed and restart Xiaomi Recorder. The module declares `com.android.soundrecorder` as its static scope.
